subject: VP/CTO Intro: Aligning on Redwood Inference Pilot & Technical Deep Dive
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Amit Sharma <amit@acmehealth.com>, Priya Anand <priya@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + Next Steps — Redwood pilot & exec intro

Hi Amit / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call:

- Goals: reduce inference costs for your LLM features and hit 99.9% p95 latency for interactive flows.
- Current pain: spiky traffic on peak hours, unclear caching strategy, wanting predictable monthly cost as usage grows.
- Next technical step: 60–90 minute deep dive with our SE (Jonas) to walk through your model topology, expected token volumes, and integration points (KV cache, routing policies).
- Executive alignment: your CTO/VP buy-in will help unblock the pilot approval and budget cadence.

To keep momentum, can we schedule two things:
1) Executive intro (VP/CTO) — 20–30 min to align on success criteria and timing.
2) Technical deep dive with Jonas — 60–90 min to scope the pilot and data/network requirements.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Nov 9, 9:00–11:00am or 2:00–4:00pm
- Wed Nov 10, 10:00–12:00pm

I've attached a short pilot proposal and a technical outline for context (redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf, technical-outline.pdf). Also linking a one-click scheduler here: https://cal.com/marissa/redwood-exec-intro

If you prefer, happy to have Laura join the exec call for contract/next-step questions — looping her in on my next message.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf, technical-outline.pdf
